worldcombat.skill.agility.summary: Become light-footed to greatly raise Speed until the effect ends or is cleansed.
worldcombat.skill.agility.use.0: Relax first at the start of a fight to lay down Speed
worldcombat.skill.agility.use.2: Regain a burst of speed between attacks once light-footed ends
worldcombat.skill.agility.description.1: Light-footed lasts %1$s, raising Speed and leaving afterimages while moving. Speed returns when it ends or is cleansed; recasting during it adds no further boost.
worldcombat.skill.agility.timing: Self move, range %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, recovers for %3$s s and starts a %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.agility.growth.0: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.agility.growth.1: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens further to %2$s s.
The companion considers relaxing only when a threat is within this distance; larger means earlier preparation.
Below this distance the companion stops relaxing and deals with the threat; larger gives up the boost more often up close.
